name: Suditi Industries Limited
about: Suditi Industries Limited processes, manufactures, and sells knitted hosiery fabrics and readymade garments in India. The company also engages in retailing business. It provides kids wear under Gini & Jony brand name; dyeing services; and garmenting services, such as cutting, stitching, printing, washing, and embroidery. Suditi Industries Limited was formerly known as Suditi Hosiery Processors Limited and changed its name to Suditi Industries Limited in October 1994. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
